INSERT INTO theme_revisions (id, tenant_id, number, parent_id, origin, change, status,
                                      source_key, created_by, prompt, ai_run_id)
         SELECT $1, $2, coalesce(max(number), 0) + 1, $3, 'custom', $4, 'draft', $5, $6, $7, $8
         FROM theme_revisions
